cross_references.note: Magnuson-Moss + Song-Beverly are the canonical state/federal warranty pair. §2311 expressly preserves state law. Plead both; Song-Beverly 2x civil penalty is additive.
Magnuson-Moss = warranty; Rees-Levering = financing. Pleads coexist without overlap.
Title/odometer fraud under §5900 is a predicate breach of implied warranty of merchantability — which Magnuson-Moss §2308 locks in whenever any written warranty was given.
CLRA (Civ §1750) and Magnuson-Moss independently attach; CLRA remedies differ (actual damages + injunctive + fees).
§11713 dealer prohibited acts do not require a warranty; Magnuson-Moss requires a written warranty. If both facts present, both claims stack.
§2310(d)(3) $50K federal AIC threshold interacts with 28 USC §1441 removal. Plaintiff forum choice matters.
